review_notes: Reviewed all 172 lines, related frame and spectral-image definitions, and uses of the target lemmas. Checked for existing cavityGroupLift simp registrations and entry lemmas. No Lean execution was performed; the proposed interface is source-based and untested.

findings.declaration: cavityGroupLift_support and the cavityGroupLift entry interface
findings.excerpt:
lemma cavityGroupLift_support {r m q t : ℕ} (g : Fin r → Fin m) (a : Fin m)
    (e : {i : Fin r // g i = a} ≃ Fin q) (B : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : g i ≠ a) (j : Fin t) : cavityGroupLift g a e B i j = 0 := by
  simp only [cavityGroupLift, hi, dite_false]
findings.problem: The lift lacks branch-selecting simp rules: the zero-entry lemma is untagged, and there is no corresponding positive-entry lemma. Consequently, the entrywise proofs repeatedly expose its dependent-if implementation. With hi : g i ≠ a, the canonical form of cavityGroupLift g a e B i j is 0; with hi : g i = a, it is B (e ⟨i, hi⟩) j.
findings.proposed_change: Mark cavityGroupLift_support @[simp] and add an @[simp] lemma cavityGroupLift_apply_of_eq with the same parameters and conclusion `(hi : g i = a) → cavityGroupLift g a e B i j = B (e ⟨i, hi⟩) j` (binding hi explicitly). Use these entry rules in the Gram, restriction, and projection proofs rather than repeatedly unfolding cavityGroupLift. Do not mark the entire definition simp.
findings.benefit: Provides computation through the abstraction boundary without expanding lifts when group membership is unknown. Both orientations eliminate the evaluated lift rather than introduce another one, and require no nonemptiness assumptions, so empty index types remain covered.
